renderings.kjv: as soon as he was come

renderings.bsb: to come to me before winter

elsewhere.note: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”
He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.
Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.
who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same…
requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.
When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.
In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,
